name: Tiffins at Poovar Island Resort
signature_dish: Round-the-clock Kerala, Continental and Chinese dishes on a boat-access island
why_it_matters: The main multi-cuisine restaurant of Poovar Island Resort — a resort reachable only by boat, set where the Neyyar river, backwater and Arabian Sea meet. Tiffins is open round the clock and serves Kerala, Continental and Chinese food; it is the principal dining option on the island itself.
insider_tip: Reaching the island needs the resort boat, so this is mostly for staying guests or pre-arranged visitors — call ahead. Located behind the swimming pool; ask for the Kerala dishes, which guests rate highest.
signature_address: Poovar Island Resort, Pozhiyoor, Poovar, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695513

name: Chilli's Floating Restaurant Poovar
signature_dish: Seafood eaten on a restaurant built on pillars in the backwater
why_it_matters: A floating restaurant built on pillars in the Poovar backwater, reached by boat — Poovar has three or four such floating non-veg restaurants docked in the river in front of the resorts, and Chilli's is the best-known. The novelty is the setting: eating seafood as the structure sways gently on the river with the sunset over the water.
insider_tip: Book your meal in advance and the restaurant sends a boat to collect you. Be aware seafood prices on the floating restaurants run high — well above a comparable hotel — and freshness can vary; treat it as an experience as much as a meal.
signature_address: Chilli's Floating Restaurant, Poovar backwaters, near Club Mahindra Resort Road, Poovar, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695513

name: Ripples at Estuary Sarovar Premiere
signature_dish: Kerala cuisine and buffets with views of both the sea and the backwater
why_it_matters: The backwater-and-beachfront restaurant of Estuary Sarovar Premiere on Poovar Island, set with views of both the sea and the backwater. Guests repeatedly say the Kerala food here beats other resorts and five-stars in the area — a comfortable resort restaurant with a seafood specialty section and halal options.
insider_tip: The Kerala dishes are the standout — order those over the buffet international fare. Tea-time snacks are a highlight. Reserve ahead; non-residents should call as the resort is on the island.
signature_address: Estuary Sarovar Premiere, Poovar Island, Poovar, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695513

name: Open House at The Travancore Heritage
signature_dish: Open-air Kerala and Ayurvedic dishes overlooking Chowara Beach
why_it_matters: The open-air multi-cuisine restaurant of The Travancore Heritage Beach Resort at Chowara, about 8 km north of Poovar on the coast road. The resort is well regarded for fresh, flavourful Kerala and Ayurvedic meals, and the open-air dining room over Chowara Beach makes it a characterful stop on the Poovar-Kovalam coast.
insider_tip: It is at Chowara/Kottukal, a short drive north of Poovar village — convenient on the Poovar-Kovalam route. Ask for the Kerala and Ayurvedic dishes; non-residents should call ahead.
signature_address: The Travancore Heritage Beach Resort, Chowara, Kottukal, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695501
